name: i9_10_topfloor_team_info_popup
note: AUTHORED, NOT_RUN in TopFloor sliceA: the 1on1 stream owns the shared VC binaries/ports. Drives the stock NewRankWindow.clickCell body for MID 291 (ARENA_RANK) and MID 295 (ARENA_MODE_RANK_INFO) and asserts the opened arena_team_info window recomputes power from the returned Hero/Pet rows. The rank list layout is not exercised; the stock callback method is called with the stock row shape. Requires a task rotation whose rule accepts the saved defense (not Camp/Ban/Leader on this provisioned roster) and a normal-rank fixture; run on a fresh database after the binaries are rebuilt by the owning stream.
steps: lua:local m=xyd.WindowManager.get() if m:getWindow('edit_player_name') then m:closeWindow('edit_player_name') end local w=m:getWindow('arena') assert(w and not w.isShowArenaMode,'vc-popup-arena-missing')

lua:local a=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.ARENA) local hs={} for _,h in pairs(xyd.selfPlayer:getHeros()) do table.insert(hs,h) if #hs>=5 then break end end a:saveArenaDefenderData({defenseHeroes=hs}) __vcNormalDefense=#hs

lua:__tfDone=0 __tfTickets=5 __tfLast=0 function __tfCycle() local a=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.ARENA) local ids={} for _,h in pairs(xyd.selfPlayer:getHeros()) do if #ids<5 then table.insert(ids,h:getHeroID()) end end local e=nil for _,c in ipairs(a:getEnemies()) do if c.table_id~=__tfLast then e=c end end __tfLast=e.table_id xyd.Backend.get():request(xyd.mid.START_FIGHT,{formation=table.concat(ids,'|'),enemy_id=e.table_id,is_avenge=0,campaign_type=xyd.CampaignType.ARENA},function(code,body) if code~=xyd.error.OK then print('vc-tf-start-refused',body.error_code) return end if #body.battle_report==0 then return end __tfDone=__tfDone+1 __tfTickets=__tfTickets-1 local function reload() xyd.Backend.get():request(xyd.mid.LOAD_ARENA_PLAYER_LIST,{}) end xyd.Backend.get():request(xyd.mid.ARENA_RESET_TIMER,{},function() if __tfTickets>0 then reload() return end xyd.Backend.get():request(xyd.mid.ARENA_BUY_TICKET,{},function() __tfTickets=5 reload() end) end) end) end

lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('arena') local a=w.arena_ assert(w.isShowArenaMode and a.modeType and a.modeType>0,'vc-task-not-admitted') local t=a.modeType local size=(t==xyd.ArenaModeType.SINGLE or t==xyd.ArenaModeType.PHANTOM) and 1 or t==xyd.ArenaModeType.TRIPLE and 3 or 5 local hs={} for _,h in pairs(xyd.selfPlayer:getHeros()) do if #hs<size then table.insert(hs,h) end end local leader=t==xyd.ArenaModeType.LEAD and hs[1]:getHeroID() or 0 a:saveModeDefenderData({defenseHeroes=hs,pet_id=0,leader_id=leader},function() __vcModeDefense=true end)

lua:local rl=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.RANK_LIST) rl:delRankInfoByType(xyd.SubRankType.ARENA_RANK) rl:loadRankList({xyd.SubRankType.ARENA_RANK},true,function(code,reply) assert(code==xyd.error.OK,'vc-popup-rank-list') local info=reply.rank_list[1].rank_info assert(info and info.rank_info and #info.rank_info>0,'vc-popup-rank-empty') __vcRankRow=info.rank_info[1] end)

lua:function __vcPopup(tag) local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('arena_team_info') assert(w and w.team,'vc-'..tag..'-no-window') assert(w.team.heroes and #w.team.heroes>0,'vc-'..tag..'-no-heroes') assert(type(w.team.force)=='number' and w.team.force>0,'vc-'..tag..'-power') assert(w.team.rank and w.team.rank>0,'vc-'..tag..'-rank') return w.team.force end __vcClick=import('app.windows.NewRankWindow').clickCell
